in_hebrew.name: Fendig
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Follower of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fendig הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'hendeixo', meaning 'to serve'. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes devotion and commitment to God.

in_greek.name: Fendig

in_greek.long_meaning: Fendig είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'hendeixo', meaning 'to serve'. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes devotion and commitment to God.

in_latin.name: Fendig
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Follower of God
in_latin.long_meaning: Fendig est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'hendeixo', meaning 'to serve'. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes devotion and commitment to God.
